name: Phylactery of Heresy
body:
Price 1,000 gp; Aura faint divination; CL 1st; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This cursed item appears to work like a phylactery of faithfulness, but instead guides the wearer to commit acts that will adversely affect her alignment or cause her to lose favor with her deity.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 500 gp; Feats Craft Cursed Item; Spells detect chaos, detect evil, detect good, detect law
